excerpt.zh:
对[from.GetName]进行的地表探险发现了这一改造的外勤站以及它唯一的居住者。

她自称是一名被困多年的科学家，在这片恶劣的星球里孤身生存至今，如今愿以她的专业知识换取[root.Owner.GetName]的救援。
excerpt.en:

texts.zh:
对[from.GetName]进行的地表探险发现了这一改造的外勤站以及它唯一的居住者。

她自称是一名被困多年的科学家，在这片恶劣的星球里孤身生存至今，如今愿以她的专业知识换取[root.Owner.GetName]的救援。
texts.en:
A surface expedition to [from.GetName] located the repurposed field station and its lone occupant.

Identifying herself as a stranded scientist who has endured this harsh world for years, she offers her expertise to the [root.Owner.GetName] in exchange for rescue.

label.zh: 她的经验可是无价之宝。
给她一艘飞船和一些物资。
label.en: Gift her a shuttle and supplies.

label.zh: 真有趣。摧毁她的庇护所。

texts.zh:
一位形容枯槁的[scru_species.GetClass]走出她改装为居所的外勤站。当她谈及自己在[from.From.GetName]上的遭遇时，从她[scru_species.GetMouthName]中发出的声音沙哑破碎；言语断断续续。

“请原谅……我已经很多年……没有和人说过话了……”
texts.en:
An emaciated [scru_species.GetClass] steps out of her hab-converted field station. When she speaks of her ordeal on [from.From.GetName], the sounds from her [scru_species.GetMouthName] rasps; words arrive in fits and starts.

"Forgive me. I have not... spoken to another in many years..."

label.zh: 你为什么落难到这里了？

label.en: How did you survive here for so long?

label.zh: 你还想和同类们重见吗？
label.en: Do you not want to rejoin your own kind?
What can you do for us?
